CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_helios_ports_before_release()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'released'::public.prep_status
     and old.status is distinct from 'released'::public.prep_status
     and exists (
       select 1
       from public.prep_items i
       where i.prep_ticket_id = new.id
         and i.equipment_type = 'Helios'
         and i.purpose in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose)
         and not (
           coalesce(i.helios_camera1_ports_ok,false)
           and coalesce(i.helios_camera2_ports_ok,false)
           and coalesce(i.helios_ptz_ports_ok,false)
           and coalesce(i.helios_speaker_ports_ok,false)
         )
     )
  then
    raise exception 'Helios Camera 1, Camera 2, PTZ, and IP Speaker device/router port checks must all be verified before Service handoff';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_service_helios_alibi_check_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.completed_at is not null
     and exists(
       select 1 from public.prep_items i
       where i.prep_ticket_id=new.prep_ticket_id
         and i.equipment_type='Helios'
         and i.purpose in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'SWAP'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose)
     )
     and not coalesce(new.helios_yard_alibi_visible_ok,false)
  then
    raise exception 'Verify that the Helios cameras are visible in the Alibi app before completing the Service check';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_it_helios_deploy_checks_v1(p_item_id uuid, p_camera1_hardware_ok boolean, p_camera2_hardware_ok boolean, p_ptz_assembly_ok boolean, p_proxicast_4x4_ok boolean, p_router_sim_ok boolean, p_speaker_24v_ok boolean, p_cameras_12v_ok boolean, p_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok boolean, p_cerbo_network_ok boolean, p_cerbo_vrm_ok boolean, p_rear_unit_tag_ok boolean, p_battery_box_installed_ok boolean, p_battery_120v_charged_ok boolean, p_camera_router_programming_ok boolean, p_alibi_vigilant_ok boolean, p_3x1tb_sd_ok boolean, p_camera1_ports_ok boolean, p_camera2_ports_ok boolean, p_ptz_ports_ok boolean, p_speaker_ports_ok boolean, p_sim_ok boolean, p_camera_app_ok boolean, p_customer_email_app_ok boolean, p_monitoring_ok boolean, p_sd_formatted_ok boolean, p_recording_ok boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_status public.prep_status;
  v_type text;
  v_purpose public.prep_purpose;
  v_ready boolean;
  v_customer_specific boolean;
begin
  perform public.require_role(array['it'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role]);
  select t.status,i.equipment_type,i.purpose
    into v_status,v_type,v_purpose
  from public.prep_items i
  join public.prep_tickets t on t.id=i.prep_ticket_id
  where i.id=p_item_id
  for update of i,t;
  if not found then raise exception 'Prep item not found'; end if;
  if v_status<>'draft'::public.prep_status then raise exception 'Only draft equipment prep can be edited'; end if;
  if v_type<>'Helios' or v_purpose not in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'SWAP'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose) then
    raise exception 'Helios deploy checks apply only to DELIVERY, SWAP, or BACKUP Helios items';
  end if;

  v_customer_specific := v_purpose in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'SWAP'::public.prep_purpose);

  update public.prep_items set
    helios_camera1_hardware_ok=coalesce(p_camera1_hardware_ok,false),
    helios_camera2_hardware_ok=coalesce(p_camera2_hardware_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_assembly_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_assembly_ok,false),
    helios_proxicast_4x4_ok=coalesce(p_proxicast_4x4_ok,false),
    helios_router_sim_ok=coalesce(p_router_sim_ok,false),
    helios_speaker_24v_ok=coalesce(p_speaker_24v_ok,false),
    helios_cameras_12v_ok=coalesce(p_cameras_12v_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok,false),
    helios_cerbo_network_ok=coalesce(p_cerbo_network_ok,false),
    helios_cerbo_vrm_ok=coalesce(p_cerbo_vrm_ok,false),
    helios_rear_unit_tag_ok=coalesce(p_rear_unit_tag_ok,false),
    helios_battery_box_installed_ok=coalesce(p_battery_box_installed_ok,false),
    helios_battery_120v_charged_ok=coalesce(p_battery_120v_charged_ok,false),
    helios_camera_router_programming_ok=coalesce(p_camera_router_programming_ok,false),
    helios_alibi_vigilant_ok=coalesce(p_alibi_vigilant_ok,false),
    helios_3x1tb_sd_ok=coalesce(p_3x1tb_sd_ok,false),
    helios_camera1_ports_ok=coalesce(p_camera1_ports_ok,false),
    helios_camera2_ports_ok=coalesce(p_camera2_ports_ok,false),
    helios_ptz_ports_ok=coalesce(p_ptz_ports_ok,false),
    helios_speaker_ports_ok=coalesce(p_speaker_ports_ok,false),
    delivery_sim_ok=coalesce(p_sim_ok,false),
    delivery_camera_app_ok=coalesce(p_camera_app_ok,false),
    delivery_customer_email_app_ok=case when v_customer_specific then coalesce(p_customer_email_app_ok,false) else false end,
    delivery_batteries_charged_ok=coalesce(p_battery_120v_charged_ok,false),
    delivery_monitoring_ok=case when v_customer_specific then coalesce(p_monitoring_ok,false) else false end,
    delivery_ticket_count_ok=true,
    delivery_sd_formatted_ok=coalesce(p_sd_formatted_ok,false),
    delivery_recording_ok=coalesce(p_recording_ok,false)
  where id=p_item_id;

  select
    nullif(trim(unit_tag),'') is not null
    and coalesce(power_ok,false)
    and coalesce(functions_ok,false)
    and coalesce(safe_ok,false)
    and coalesce(battery_count,0)>=greatest(1,coalesce(required_battery_count,0))
    and helios_camera1_hardware_ok and helios_camera2_hardware_ok and helios_ptz_assembly_ok
    and helios_proxicast_4x4_ok and helios_router_sim_ok and helios_speaker_24v_ok and helios_cameras_12v_ok
    and helios_ptz_plate_4bolts_ok and helios_cerbo_network_ok and helios_cerbo_vrm_ok and helios_rear_unit_tag_ok
    and helios_battery_box_installed_ok and helios_battery_120v_charged_ok and helios_camera_router_programming_ok
    and helios_alibi_vigilant_ok and helios_3x1tb_sd_ok
    and helios_camera1_ports_ok and helios_camera2_ports_ok and helios_ptz_ports_ok and helios_speaker_ports_ok
    and delivery_sim_ok and delivery_camera_app_ok and delivery_batteries_charged_ok
    and delivery_sd_formatted_ok and delivery_recording_ok
    and (not v_customer_specific or (delivery_customer_email_app_ok and delivery_monitoring_ok))
  into v_ready
  from public.prep_items where id=p_item_id;

  update public.prep_items
  set verified_by=case when v_ready then auth.uid() else null end,
      verified_at=case when v_ready then now() else null end
  where id=p_item_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: save_it_helios_port_checks
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_it_helios_port_checks(p_item_id uuid, p_camera1_ports_ok boolean, p_camera2_ports_ok boolean, p_ptz_ports_ok boolean, p_speaker_ports_ok boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_status public.prep_status;
  v_type text;
  v_purpose public.prep_purpose;
  v_ready boolean;
  v_deploy_ready boolean;
begin
  perform public.require_role(array['it'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role]);

  select t.status, i.equipment_type, i.purpose
  into v_status, v_type, v_purpose
  from public.prep_items i
  join public.prep_tickets t on t.id = i.prep_ticket_id
  where i.id = p_item_id
  for update of i,t;

  if not found then raise exception 'Prep item not found'; end if;
  if v_status <> 'draft'::public.prep_status then
    raise exception 'Return the Service handoff to IT before editing. Completed Service verification is locked.';
  end if;
  if v_type <> 'Helios' or v_purpose not in ('DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose,'BACKUP'::public.prep_purpose) then
    raise exception 'Helios port checks apply only to deployable DELIVERY/BACKUP Helios items';
  end if;

  update public.prep_items
  set helios_camera1_ports_ok = coalesce(p_camera1_ports_ok,false),
      helios_camera2_ports_ok = coalesce(p_camera2_ports_ok,false),
      helios_ptz_ports_ok = coalesce(p_ptz_ports_ok,false),
      helios_speaker_ports_ok = coalesce(p_speaker_ports_ok,false)
  where id = p_item_id;

  select case
    when v_purpose='DELIVERY'::public.prep_purpose then
      coalesce(delivery_sim_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_camera_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_customer_email_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_batteries_charged_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_monitoring_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_ticket_count_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_sd_formatted_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_recording_ok,false)
    else
      coalesce(delivery_sim_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_camera_app_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_batteries_charged_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_sd_formatted_ok,false)
      and coalesce(delivery_recording_ok,false)
  end
  into v_deploy_ready
  from public.prep_items
  where id=p_item_id;

  select
    nullif(trim(unit_tag),'') is not null
    and coalesce(power_ok,false)
    and coalesce(functions_ok,false)
    and coalesce(safe_ok,false)
    and coalesce(battery_count,0) >= coalesce(required_battery_count,0)
    and v_deploy_ready
    and coalesce(helios_camera1_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_camera2_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_ptz_ports_ok,false)
    and coalesce(helios_speaker_ports_ok,false)
  into v_ready
  from public.prep_items
  where id = p_item_id;

  update public.prep_items
  set verified_by = case when v_ready then auth.uid() else null end,
      verified_at = case when v_ready then now() else null end
  where id = p_item_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_departure_readiness_v1(p_service_tech_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_profile public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_caller public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_today date := timezone('America/Chicago',now())::date;
  v_inspection_ready boolean := false;
  v_inventory_ready boolean := false;
  v_units jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_sims jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_stock jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_check jsonb := null;
  v_restock jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_active_restock integer := 0;
begin
  select * into v_caller from public.profiles where user_id=auth.uid() and active=true;
  if not found then raise exception 'Active account required.'; end if;
  if p_service_tech_id<>auth.uid() and v_caller.role::text not in ('it','owner') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized to view another technician truck.';
  end if;

  select * into v_profile
  from public.profiles
  where user_id=p_service_tech_id and active=true and role::text='service';
  if not found then raise exception 'Active Service Tech required.'; end if;

  perform public.ensure_service_truck_baseline_v1(p_service_tech_id);
  perform public.refresh_service_truck_restock_requests_v1();

  select exists(
    select 1 from public.morning_checks mc
    where mc.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id
      and timezone('America/Chicago',mc.submitted_at)::date=v_today
      and jsonb_typeof(mc.truck_checks)='object'
      and (select count(*) from jsonb_each(mc.truck_checks))=8
      and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(mc.truck_checks) x where x.value<>'true'::jsonb)
      and (
        not mc.taking_trailer
        or (
          jsonb_typeof(mc.trailer_checks)='object'
          and (select count(*) from jsonb_each(mc.trailer_checks))=7
          and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(mc.trailer_checks) y where y.value<>'true'::jsonb)
        )
      )
  ) into v_inspection_ready;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'equipment_type',u.equipment_type,
    'unit_tag',u.unit_tag,
    'status',u.status,
    'last_used_ticket_no',u.last_used_ticket_no,
    'last_used_at',u.last_used_at,
    'old_unit_tag',u.old_unit_tag
  ) order by case u.equipment_type when 'Sniper' then 1 when 'Ranger' then 2 when 'Spotter' then 3 else 4 end),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_units
  from public.service_truck_units u
  where u.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'slot_no',s.slot_no,
    'sim_number',s.sim_number,
    'status',s.status,
    'last_used_ticket_no',s.last_used_ticket_no,
    'last_used_at',s.last_used_at,
    'assigned_by_name',s.assigned_by_name,
    'assigned_at',s.assigned_at
  ) order by s.slot_no),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_sims
  from public.service_truck_sims s
  where s.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'recon_battery_qty',s.recon_battery_qty,
    'agm_12v_110ah_qty',s.agm_12v_110ah_qty,
    'litime_12v_100ah_qty',s.litime_12v_100ah_qty,
    'battery_12v_35ah_qty',s.battery_12v_35ah_qty,
    'updated_at',s.updated_at
  ) into v_stock
  from public.service_truck_stock s
  where s.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id',c.id,'ready',c.ready,'missing_items',c.missing_items,
    'unit_confirmations',c.unit_confirmations,
    'sim_confirmations',c.sim_confirmations,
    'recon_battery_qty',c.recon_battery_qty,
    'agm_12v_110ah_qty',c.agm_12v_110ah_qty,
    'litime_12v_100ah_qty',c.litime_12v_100ah_qty,
    'battery_12v_35ah_qty',c.battery_12v_35ah_qty,
    'submitted_at',c.submitted_at
  ) into v_check
  from public.service_truck_inventory_checks c
  where c.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id and c.check_date=v_today;

  select count(*) into v_active_restock
  from public.service_truck_restock_requests r
  where r.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id and r.status not in ('issued','cancelled');

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,'item_kind',r.item_kind,'item_type',r.item_type,'qty_needed',r.qty_needed,
    'qty_issued',r.qty_issued,'used_unit_tag',r.used_unit_tag,'old_unit_tag',r.old_unit_tag,
    'sim_slot_no',r.sim_slot_no,'used_sim_number',r.used_sim_number,'replacement_sim_number',r.replacement_sim_number,
    'original_ticket_no',r.original_ticket_no,'reason',r.reason,'status',r.status,
    'replacement_unit_tag',r.replacement_unit_tag,'prepared_by_name',r.prepared_by_name,
    'prepared_at',r.prepared_at,'requested_at',r.requested_at
  ) order by r.requested_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_restock
  from public.service_truck_restock_requests r
  where r.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id and r.status not in ('issued','cancelled');

  select coalesce(c.ready,false)
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.service_truck_units u
      where u.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id
        and (u.status<>'assigned' or u.unit_tag is null or btrim(u.unit_tag)='')
    )
    and 3=(
      select count(*) from public.service_truck_sims s
      where s.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id
        and s.status='assigned'
        and s.sim_number is not null
        and btrim(s.sim_number)<>''
    )
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.service_truck_stock s
      where s.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id
        and s.recon_battery_qty>=25
        and s.agm_12v_110ah_qty>=4
        and s.litime_12v_100ah_qty>=2
        and s.battery_12v_35ah_qty>=4
    )
  into v_inventory_ready
  from public.service_truck_inventory_checks c
  where c.service_tech_id=p_service_tech_id and c.check_date=v_today;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'service_tech_id',p_service_tech_id,
    'service_tech_name',coalesce(v_profile.full_name,v_profile.username,'Service Tech'),
    'check_date',v_today,
    'inspection_ready',coalesce(v_inspection_ready,false),
    'inventory_ready',coalesce(v_inventory_ready,false),
    'departure_ready',coalesce(v_inspection_ready,false) and coalesce(v_inventory_ready,false),
    'required',jsonb_build_object(
      'units',jsonb_build_array('Sniper','Ranger','Spotter','Solar Spotter'),
      'sim_qty',3,
      'recon_battery_qty',25,
      'agm_12v_110ah_qty',4,
      'litime_12v_100ah_qty',2,
      'battery_12v_35ah_qty',4
    ),
    'units',v_units,
    'sims',v_sims,
    'stock',coalesce(v_stock,'{}'::jsonb),
    'today_check',v_check,
    'restock_requests',v_restock
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_service_truck_baseline_v1(p_service_tech_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role text;
begin
  select role::text into v_role
  from public.profiles
  where user_id=p_service_tech_id and active=true;
  if v_role is distinct from 'service' then return; end if;

  insert into public.service_truck_units(service_tech_id,equipment_type)
  values
    (p_service_tech_id,'Sniper'),
    (p_service_tech_id,'Ranger'),
    (p_service_tech_id,'Spotter'),
    (p_service_tech_id,'Solar Spotter')
  on conflict (service_tech_id,equipment_type) do nothing;

  insert into public.service_truck_stock(service_tech_id)
  values(p_service_tech_id)
  on conflict (service_tech_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.service_truck_sims(service_tech_id,slot_no)
  values
    (p_service_tech_id,1),
    (p_service_tech_id,2),
    (p_service_tech_id,3)
  on conflict (service_tech_id,slot_no) do nothing;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_service_truck_restock_requests_v1()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  update public.service_truck_restock_requests r
  set status='requested', updated_at=now()
  where r.status='awaiting_return'
    and r.old_unit_tag is not null
    and exists(
      select 1
      from public.unit_returns ur
      where ur.service_tech_id=r.service_tech_id
        and trim(ur.ticket_no)=trim(r.original_ticket_no)
        and lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(ur.unit_tag,''),'[^a-zA-Z0-9]','','g'))
            = lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(r.old_unit_tag,''),'[^a-zA-Z0-9]','','g'))
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restart_service_verification_questions_v1(p_prep_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.app_role;
  v_ticket text;
begin
  v_role:=public.current_app_role();
  if v_role not in ('service'::public.app_role,'owner'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'Service or Owner access required';
  end if;

  select ticket_no into v_ticket
  from public.prep_tickets
  where id=p_prep_id and status='released';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Service handoff not found or no longer waiting for Service';
  end if;

  if v_role='service'::public.app_role and not exists(
    select 1
    from public.job_assignments a
    where a.assigned_role='service'
      and (a.prep_ticket_id=p_prep_id or trim(a.ticket_no)=trim(v_ticket))
      and a.assignee_user_id=auth.uid()
      and a.status in ('assigned','started','completed')
  ) then
    raise exception 'This Service handoff is not assigned to you';
  end if;

  update public.prep_items
  set service_battery_count=null,
      service_unit_confirmed=false,
      service_verified_by=null,
      service_verified_at=null
  where prep_ticket_id=p_prep_id;

  update public.prep_tickets
  set service_parts_confirmed=false,
      service_parts_confirmed_by=null,
      service_parts_confirmed_by_name=null,
      service_parts_confirmed_at=null
  where id=p_prep_id;

  update public.service_solar_checks
  set stand_verified=false,
      battery_configuration=null,
      mppt_updated_ok=false,
      mppt_tested_ok=false,
      cerbo_updated_ok=false,
      cerbo_online_ok=false,
      solar_panel_count=0,
